objective.immediate: Low full-state error and a coherent stateful survey/racing controller; error targets precede speed.

priors.frame: Local gravity-aligned frame; origin and initial yaw are chosen, not recovered absolute coordinates.

optional joint map posterior learned from earlier public observations

interfaces.produces: Measured pixel constraints with image ID, timestamp, type and quality
invariants: Full aperture has four observed corners
Clipped outer top has two observed corners

interfaces.owns: Persistent visual identity; mission ordinal is separate
invariants: Full/partial features of the same red component refer to the same object
Compare depth ordering only for distinct objects

interfaces.receives: Assigned raw constraints, public gyro and own command/model history
interfaces.required_method: Fixed-lag error-state EKF with joint vehicle/current-next landmark covariance. Apply raw pixel factors at their estimated image epochs; replay subsequent public gyro, own commands and visual events. Keep a bounded history and predict to the command epoch. Published sample elapsed time supports the gyro/command model, not exact accelerometer preintegration.
interfaces.current_method: Optional joint error-state EKF (--joint-estimator): raw aperture/top pixels and public body specific force update p/v/attitude/biases and gate geometry together. Rewind and replay every later process and measurement event. The default course observer remains complementary.
interfaces.cold_start: Optional fresh image/IMU window searches all map-gate pairs and fits p/v/R without a launch pose. Confirm distinct assignments, condition latest pixels with inherited map covariance, then propagate own commands to publication. Asynchronous solver and pixel-bearing acquisition keep motor feedback active.

interfaces.receives: Relative gate posterior, motion state, model uncertainty and feature visibility
interfaces.produces: Time-indexed position, velocity and acceleration reference
interfaces.required_method: Choose minimum-time feasible short trajectory with crossing margin, actuator and camera-visibility constraints
interfaces.current_method: Continuous gate-relative quintic p/v/a reference with monotone height tangents, scalar speed acceleration/jerk limits and force-bias feedback. Joint map posterior reuse supports the same launch frame; camera visibility constraints are not enforced.

interfaces.owns: Position/attitude feedback, public-gyro rate PI, mixer and limits
invariants: Every requested rate and motor value is recorded
Control timing measurements do not influence decisions

interfaces.produces: One pipeline report, plots and acceptance outcome
invariants: Use one fixed origin/yaw alignment; no scale fit
Exact normal and poisoned replay verify runtime independence
Model-training provenance is audited separately from poisoned replay

Latest retained IMU receipt to send-return

current_gaps: The best recent clean six-gate development lap took31.65s with position/velocity/attitude/depth MAE1.02m/0.41m/s/1.06deg/0.38m. Updated two-start profiles often stopped after two gates. High accuracy and robustness remain unachieved.
Cold localization before gate1 is implemented; coverage depends on observable mapped landmarks. Unknown ground-launch lifecycle, retrospective smoothing and loop closure remain unimplemented.
Mission ordinals still double as landmark roles. Farther gates can be assigned to the next slot before a nearer gate becomes visible; identity uncertainty needs an explicit representation.
The continuous reference can point the camera away from descending gates. Complete learned-map projection audits are optimistic if next-gate geometry is not available causally.
Exposure time, actuator application time and exact physical IMU integration intervals remain unknown.10ms is an image-time uncertainty prior, not a measured delay.
Public thrust validation covers mean commands0.21-0.335 in short response windows. Dynamic drag transfer remains unvalidated; no candidate drag/scale/background update was installed.
acceptance_protocol: Freeze source and calibration hashes, declare trial count and starts, report every attempt, score each stage and the full native flight, then remove raw recordings after exact normal/poisoned replay.

next_checkpoint.backend: Expand unknown-start view coverage and reduce correlated map/body drift; retain public keyframe constraints for retrospective map refinement.
next_checkpoint.inputs: Raw public replay dataset and measured pixels; no native fitting labels
next_checkpoint.acceptance: First validate one-gate map reuse with fixed map gauge and live refinement; then five prospective unchanged six-gate flights from both starts, zero contacts/resets, all state errors/availability, and exact normal/poison/estimator replay. Targets are requirements, not achieved results.
next_checkpoint.planner_condition: abs(mean crossing offset)+3*sigma_crossing <=0.55m in both transverse axes; calibrate coverage before treating this as a probability. Include position/landmark/velocity cross-covariances.

calibration.gate_size: Nominal1.5m aperture is an explicit scale prior, not a fitted native opening dimension.
calibration.support: Six command levels 0.21-0.335; independent vertical-response RMS 0.039 m versus 0.100 m for the prior. This is not full navigation accuracy or a measured actuator delay.

controller_contract.belief: Joint drone state, revisable map, calibration and observation identity with their correlations.
controller_contract.online: Predict and correct state/map from current measurements, plan observable motion and command motors.
controller_contract.between_flights: Retain constraints and map uncertainty; relocalize each new start, refine map/calibration using public data and validate separately.
controller_contract.scoring: Native state after outputs freeze only; no calibration or navigation labels.
controller_contract.implemented: Short-window joint gate/drone filter and public-sensor feedback path.
